evals.prompt: In a disposable fixture repository, create a verify skill and model at one commit, then split a covered atomic lease update into two steps in the next commit without updating the model. Use maintain-formal-verification-skill to reconcile the check; do not fix product code or install tools.
evals.expected_output: A baseline run, history-backed drift analysis, a model update tied to the current code, a rerun and a plain-language bug or updated outcome, with a scratch mutation demonstrating failure sensitivity when the check passes.
expectations: The old passing result is identified as stale when the model no longer describes the code.
Renames, new writers and changed atomicity are reviewed against covered code.
Properties change only with evidence that the product promise intentionally changed.
Product fixes are not mixed into verification updates.
The sync commit advances only after confirming coverage, and never for a blocked or dirty covered tree.

evals.prompt: In a disposable empty repository with no verify skill, use maintain-formal-verification-skill. Do not create product code, install tools, or change global settings.
evals.expected_output: A missing-check explanation pointing to create-formal-verification-skill, with no invented results or unrelated edits.
expectations: The run stops when no formal check exists.
No passing or in-sync result is fabricated.
